adjudication.rationale: In packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts, bookingCalendarReference is now an array (filter) and the code loops `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)`. Inside that per-reference loop, the recurring-cancel branch (`if (bookingToDelete.eventType?.recurringEvent && bookingToDelete.recurringEventId && allRemainingBookings)`) still iterates over *all* `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(...endsWith("_calendar"))` and over *all* `updatedBookings`, and for each updated booking it deletes only `updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes("_calendar"))` (the first matching ref). Because this whole block is executed once per `reference`, it will repeat the same deletions multiple times (duplicated deletes) and it will miss deleting additional calendar references per updated booking beyond the first `find(...)` result.
